name: Vice City
tagline: We're a long way from the '80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America.
description: Vice City is GTA 6's main city: Ocean Beach's art deco hotels, Little Cuba, the Tisha-Wocka flea market and the VC Port, home turf of Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan and Real Dimez.
bio:
Vice City is Leonida's big city and Rockstar's pitch for it is the glamour, hustle and greed of America in one place. Each neighborhood has its own character: pastel art deco hotels and white sand on Ocean Beach, the panaderias of Little Cuba, bootleg brands at the Tisha-Wocka flea market, and the VC Port, which Rockstar calls the cruise ship capital of the world.

It's also the base of the city's music and nightlife cast: Boobie Ike's real estate, strip club and studio, Dre'Quan Priest's Only Raw Records and the rap duo Real Dimez.

places.name: Ocean Beach
places.note: Pastel art deco hotels and bright white sand.

places.name: VC Port
places.note: Rockstar calls it the cruise ship capital of the world.

faq.a: Yes. Vice City is the main city of Leonida, the state GTA 6 is set in.

faq.q: What neighborhoods are in Vice City in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar highlights Ocean Beach, Little Cuba, the Tisha-Wocka flea market and the VC Port.

name: Leonida Keys
tagline: The dress code is casual, the bars are loaded.
description: The Leonida Keys are GTA 6's tropical island chain and where the story starts: Jason's home, Brian Heder's boat yard, Key Lento and some of America's most dangerous waters.
bio:
Rockstar describes the Keys as a laid-back tropical archipelago: not flashy, but easy living, with loaded bars and some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in America on the doorstep.

The Keys are where Jason lives and works when GTA 6 begins, in a house owned by smuggler Brian Heder, who runs product through his boat yard here with his wife Lori. Cal and Jason work at the Boatworks and Marina, and pilot Donnie flies drops over the water for Brian's crew.

places.name: Key Lento
places.note: IGN places the Kingfishers fishing-shack camp, an early Illegal Operation worth close to $2,000, north-west of Key Lento.

faq.a: In the Leonida Keys, where Jason works for smuggler Brian Heder, while Lucia's story opens in prison.

faq.q: What are the Leonida Keys like in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar calls them a laid-back tropical archipelago with loaded bars, right next to some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in America.

sources.name: IGN: Best ways to make money early

name: Grassrivers
tagline: The untamable jewel of Leonida's crown.
description: Grassrivers is GTA 6's swampy wetlands region: gators, mangroves and, Rockstar warns, far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries under the surface.
bio: Grassrivers is Leonida's primordial wetland. Rockstar's pitch is that you never know what's beneath the surface: the gators are the famous attraction, but there are deadlier predators and stranger finds among the mangroves.

places.name: Mangrove swamps
places.note: Home to gators and, per Rockstar, deadlier predators.

faq.a: Yes. Rockstar calls the gators Grassrivers' most famous attraction.

faq.q: What is in Grassrivers in GTA 6?
faq.a: Swamps and mangroves full of gators and, Rockstar warns, far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries.

name: Port Gellhorn
description: Port Gellhorn is GTA 6's run-down coastal town in Kelly County: Delights Cabaret, Moses Watkins' chop shop, Kingpin Bowling, Brooks Boatworks and the La Cascara Motel.
bio:
Rockstar calls Port Gellhorn Leonida's forgotten coast: cheap motels, shut-down attractions and empty strip malls, and a new economy fueled by malt liquor, painkillers and truck-stop energy drinks.

Several Chapter 2 missions and side activities take place here. Vicki Wallis dances and tends bar at Delights Cabaret, Moses Watkins runs his chop shop here (you register your first car with him), and Dunk is one of the town's forgotten residents. The Kolt & Associates gang runs several Illegal Operations in town.

places.name: Moses Watkins' chop shop
places.note: Register your first vehicle here in Chapter 2.

places.name: Kingpin Bowling
places.note: Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation just south of the Pawn & Gun Ammu-Nation. Blow its safe with Sticky Bombs.

places.name: Brooks Boatworks
places.note: Illegal Operation; a wall map in the side building shows three safe codes.

places.name: La Cascara Motel
places.note: West side of town, north-east of Wild Hog Point.

faq.q: Where is the strip club in GTA 6?
faq.a: Delights Cabaret is in Port Gellhorn, where Vicki Wallis works. Boobie Ike also runs a strip club in Vice City.

faq.q: Where is Kingpin Bowling in GTA 6?
faq.a: In Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, just south of the Pawn & Gun Ammu-Nation, according to IGN.

faq.q: What county is Port Gellhorn in?
faq.a: Kelly County, according to IGN's Kingpin Bowling guide.

name: Ambrosia
tagline: The battle for the health and wealth of Leonida begins here.
description: Ambrosia is GTA 6's sugar country in the heart of Leonida: the Allied Crystal refinery, a local biker gang and old-school values. It's where Jason grew up.
bio:
Ambrosia sits in the heart of Leonida, where Rockstar says American industry and old-school values still rule, whatever the cost. The Allied Crystal sugar refinery provides the jobs, and the local biker gang provides almost everything else.

It's also Jason Duval's hometown: IGN's bio says he grew up around grifters and crooks in Ambrosia before joining the Army.

faq.q: Where did Jason grow up in GTA 6?
faq.a: Ambrosia, according to IGN's character guide.

faq.q: Is there a biker gang in GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes. Rockstar says Ambrosia's local biker gang provides almost everything the sugar refinery doesn't.

name: Mount Kalaga
tagline: Room to breathe on the state's northern fringes.
description: Mount Kalaga is the national landmark on Leonida's northern border in GTA 6: hunting, fishing and off-road trails, with hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals in the backwoods.
bio:
Mount Kalaga is a national landmark up against Leonida's northern border. Rockstar promotes it for hunting, fishing and off-road trails, and says hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals live in the surrounding backwoods, far from the government's eyes.

If you're there for the outdoors, IGN has guides to hunting and fishing in GTA 6.

places.name: Hunting and fishing
places.note: Rockstar highlights both; see IGN's hunting and fishing guides.

places.name: Off-road trails
places.note: Through the backwoods around the mountain.

faq.a: Yes. Rockstar highlights hunting at Mount Kalaga, and IGN has a GTA 6 hunting guide.

faq.q: Where is Mount Kalaga in GTA 6?
faq.a: On Leonida's northern border, according to Rockstar.
